b: Made another post about how I struggle to be on time. I am ALWAYS 5-7 minutes late to everything. I hate it
Thanks to the people of this sub, I have been on time to work 3 times this week!! I haven't done that like, ever!!!!
I bought a bunch of mini analog clocks to set up around my house, and it's been crazyyyy helpful

I also stopped worrying about my commute so much. Someone suggested I ONLY pay attention to the time I have to leave by. It's taken a lot of stress and tediousness out of my commute. Also, since I don't know what time the train comes, and I just know what time I have to leave by, it ensures I'm there on time.
I'm so proud of myself (: thanks guys
